description: This file contains utility functions for analyzing and transforming PyTorch modules and data structures, including converting modules to nested dictionaries, tracking shape dynamism across examples, and converting tensors to meta device.

methods.name: normalize_source_name
methods.description: Replaces attribute access syntax with dictionary-style indexing in source names.

methods.name: module_to_nested_dict
methods.description: Recursively converts a PyTorch nn.Module into a nested dictionary with parameters and submodules.

methods.name: track_dynamism_across_examples
methods.description: Analyzes a list of example inputs to determine shape and value dynamism across different data samples.

methods.name: clone_and_convert_to_meta
methods.description: Clones tensors and converts them to the 'meta' device, preserving non-tensor data.
